# sensory observation of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sensoryObservationOf`](gmeow-sensoryObservationOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sensoryObservationOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose property is being observed — the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) of a sensory observation. Subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) so generic consumers can query all observations without knowing the domain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:sensoryObservationOf`](gmeow-sensoryObservationOf.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Sensor Reading

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/sensory/examples/sensor-reading.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading)#example-slices-extensions-sensory-examples-sensor-reading

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a sensor reading on the observation stack . A
# gmeow:SensoryObservation records WHAT was sensed (gmeow:sensoryObservationOf),
# WHICH gmeow:ObservableProperty (humidity), and the gmeow:SensoryQuantity result.
# A gmeow:Sensor is a gufo functional complex that is also an Agent, so it is the
# observation's gmeow:vantage — the SensoryObservation is an Observation like any
# other, just produced by an instrument on a gmeow:SensorPlatform at a location.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/sensory/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

# --- The reading: what, which property, the result, the sensor as vantage, and
#     the method (a SensoryObservation is a core Observation — it records its
#     gmeow:observationMethod like any other).
ex:obs a gmeow:SensoryObservation ;
    gmeow:sensoryObservationOf ex:greenhouse ;
    gmeow:sensoryProperty      ex:humidity ;
    gmeow:sensoryResult        ex:quantity ;
    gmeow:vantage              ex:dht22 ;
    gmeow:observationMethod    gmeow:methodInstrumentalReading .
```
